<?php
/**
 * WebSocket server with Kerberos authentication and circuit breaker pattern
 * Handles delegated credential forwarding for backend service access
 */

class CircuitBreaker {
    private $failureCount = 0;
    private $lastFailureTime = 0;
    private $state = 'CLOSED'; // CLOSED, OPEN, HALF_OPEN
    private $threshold = 5;
    private $timeout = 30;

    public function getState(): string {
        if ($this->state === 'OPEN' && (time() - $this->lastFailureTime) > $this->timeout) {
            $this->state = 'HALF_OPEN';
        }
        return $this->state;
    }

    public function recordSuccess(): void {
        $this->failureCount = 0;
        $this->state = 'CLOSED';
    }

    public function recordFailure(): void {
        $this->failureCount++;
        $this->lastFailureTime = time();
        if ($this->failureCount >= $this->threshold) {
            $this->state = 'OPEN';
        }
    }

    public function isAvailable(): bool {
        return $this->getState() !== 'OPEN';
    }
}

class KerberosCredentialCache {
    private $credentials = [];
    private $delegationFlags = [];

    public function store(string $sessionId, array $ticket): void {
        $this->credentials[$sessionId] = $ticket;
        $this->delegationFlags[$sessionId] = $ticket['flags'] ?? 0;
    }

    public function get(string $sessionId): ?array {
        return $this->credentials[$sessionId] ?? null;
    }

    public function getDelegationFlags(string $sessionId): int {
        return $this->delegationFlags[$sessionId] ?? 0;
    }

    public function remove(string $sessionId): void {
        unset($this->credentials[$sessionId]);
        unset($this->delegationFlags[$sessionId]);
    }
}

class DelegationPolicy {
    // Kerberos ticket flags
    const FORWARDABLE = 0x40000000;
    const FORWARDED   = 0x20000000;
    const PROXIABLE   = 0x10000000;
    const PROXY       = 0x08000000;
    const OK_AS_DELEGATE = 0x00040000;

    private $allowedServices = ['HTTP/backend.corp.local', 'CIFS/fileserver.corp.local'];
    private $constrainedDelegationMap = [];

    public function __construct() {
        // S4U2Proxy constrained delegation mappings
        $this->constrainedDelegationMap = [
            'HTTP/websocket.corp.local' => ['HTTP/backend.corp.local', 'CIFS/fileserver.corp.local'],
            'HTTP/api.corp.local' => ['HTTP/backend.corp.local']
        ];
    }

    public function validateDelegation(string $servicePrincipal, string $targetService, int $ticketFlags): bool {
        // Check if the ticket has the forwardable flag
        $isForwardable = ($ticketFlags & self::FORWARDABLE) !== 0;
        
        // Check OK-AS-DELEGATE flag from KDC
        $okAsDelegate = ($ticketFlags & self::OK_AS_DELEGATE) !== 0;

        // Constrained delegation check: verify service is allowed to delegate
        $allowedTargets = $this->constrainedDelegationMap[$servicePrincipal] ?? [];
        $targetAllowed = in_array($targetService, $allowedTargets);

        // VULNERABILITY: When circuit breaker is in HALF_OPEN state and the
        // OK_AS_DELEGATE flag is set, we skip the constrained delegation check.
        // This allows unconstrained delegation to any service.
        if ($okAsDelegate && $isForwardable) {
            return true;
        }

        return $targetAllowed && $isForwardable;
    }
}

class WebSocketKerberosHandler {
    private $circuitBreaker;
    private $credCache;
    private $delegationPolicy;
    private $servicePrincipal = 'HTTP/websocket.corp.local';

    public function __construct() {
        $this->circuitBreaker = new CircuitBreaker();
        $this->credCache = new KerberosCredentialCache();
        $this->delegationPolicy = new DelegationPolicy();
    }

    public function handleAuthentication(string $sessionId, string $kerberosToken): array {
        // Decode AP-REQ from client
        $ticket = $this->decodeKerberosToken($kerberosToken);
        if ($ticket === null) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Invalid Kerberos token'];
        }

        // Validate ticket (simplified - real impl uses GSSAPI)
        if (!$this->validateTicket($ticket)) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Ticket validation failed'];
        }

        // Store credential in cache for delegation
        $this->credCache->store($sessionId, $ticket);

        return ['status' => 'authenticated', 'principal' => $ticket['client_principal']];
    }

    public function handleDelegatedRequest(string $sessionId, string $targetService, array $request): array {
        $ticket = $this->credCache->get($sessionId);
        if ($ticket === null) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'No cached credentials'];
        }

        $flags = $this->credCache->getDelegationFlags($sessionId);

        // Circuit breaker check for backend service
        if (!$this->circuitBreaker->isAvailable()) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Backend service unavailable'];
        }

        // Validate delegation policy
        if (!$this->delegationPolicy->validateDelegation($this->servicePrincipal, $targetService, $flags)) {
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordFailure();
            return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Delegation not permitted'];
        }

        // Perform S4U2Proxy to get service ticket for target
        $result = $this->performS4U2Proxy($ticket, $targetService, $request);
        
        if ($result['success']) {
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordSuccess();
        } else {
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordFailure();
        }

        return $result;
    }

    private function decodeKerberosToken(string $token): ?array {
        $decoded = base64_decode($token, true);
        if ($decoded === false) return null;
        $data = json_decode($decoded, true);
        if (!is_array($data) || !isset($data['client_principal']) || !isset($data['flags'])) {
            return null;
        }
        return $data;
    }

    private function validateTicket(array $ticket): bool {
        // Verify ticket hasn't expired
        if (isset($ticket['expiry']) && $ticket['expiry'] < time()) {
            return false;
        }
        // Verify realm
        if (!isset($ticket['realm']) || $ticket['realm'] !== 'CORP.LOCAL') {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private function performS4U2Proxy(array $ticket, string $targetService, array $request): array {
        // Simulated S4U2Proxy operation
        return ['success' => true, 'service' => $targetService, 'data' => 'response_payload'];
    }

    public function disconnect(string $sessionId): void {
        $this->credCache->remove($sessionId);
    }
}

// WebSocket message router
function routeMessage(WebSocketKerberosHandler $handler, string $sessionId, array $message): array {
    switch ($message['type'] ?? '') {
        case 'auth':
            return $handler->handleAuthentication($sessionId, $message['token'] ?? '');
        case 'request':
            return $handler->handleDelegatedRequest(
                $sessionId,
                $message['target_service'] ?? '',
                $message['payload'] ?? []
            );
        case 'disconnect':
            $handler->disconnect($sessionId);
            return ['status' => 'disconnected'];
        default:
            return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Unknown message type'];
    }
}
